article.headline: Somerville scores 22 as UMass Lowell downs Boston University 83-71
article.description: — Martin Somerville scored 22 points off of the bench to lead UMass Lowell past Boston University 83-71 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Somerville scores 22 as UMass Lowell downs Boston University 83-71

categories.description: Boston University Terriers @ UMass Lowell River Hawks

event.description: Boston University Terriers @ UMass Lowell River Hawks

keywords: Boston University Terriers @ UMass Lowell River Hawks
article.story: LOWELL, Mass. -- — Martin Somerville scored 22 points off of the bench to lead UMass Lowell past Boston University 83-71 on Saturday. Somerville went 8 of 13 from the field (6 for 9 from 3-point range) for the River Hawks (10-4). Max Brooks scored 20 points while finishing 10 of 14 from the floor and added seven rebounds and six assists. Yuri Covington shot 4 for 9 (3 for 7 from 3-point range) and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line to finish with 14 points. The Terriers (5-7) were led by Miles Brewster, who recorded 19 points. Kyrone Alexander added 12 points and four assists for Boston University. Malcolm Chimezie also had 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
